report.summary: Chunk 1 of daedalus/eval/__main__.py: CLI entrypoint with argparse, mint/confirm, gate/update-baseline, project filtering, and ASCII-safe printing.
risks: main function | medium | The code references args.update_baseline but the argparse argument is --update-baseline. Python's argparse converts dashes to underscores, so args.update_baseline is correct. No risk.

_print_ascii | low | Uses sys.stdout.buffer.write; if sys.stdout is not a buffered stream (e.g., StringIO in tests), this could raise AttributeError. Use of try-except for UnicodeEncodeError only. Settled by checking if this module is ever used in tests with mocked stdout.

handoff.purpose: Define CLI entry point with argument parsing, project filtering, minting/confirming tasks, and ASCII-safe printing.

symbols.name: _select
symbols.note: Filters tasks by project label; exits if no match.

symbols.name: _print_ascii
symbols.note: Prints text, falling back to ASCII-encoded write on UnicodeEncodeError.

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: Entry point handling --mint-commit and --confirm-mint which write to the mint store.

claims.why: This chunk does not contain the code that runs tier 1; it only imports run_tier1. Cannot verify that it always runs.

claims.text: --arms adds the deterministic A/B/C retrieval comparison (also no LLM).
claims.why: This chunk imports run_arms but does not show its execution. Cannot verify that it is deterministic and LLM-free.

claims.text: Tier 2 runs only with --tier2 AND a reachable provider; otherwise it is skipped with a clear message.
claims.why: This chunk imports run_tier2 but does not show the logic for checking provider reachability or the skip message.

claims.text: --gate is an ADVISORY local regression check against baseline.json -- see daedalus.eval.harness.run_gate.
claims.why: This chunk does not include the --gate handling code; it only defines the argument. The referenced function run_gate is not imported or used in this chunk.

claims.text: --update-baseline is the only thing that writes baseline.json, and only when explicitly passed.
claims.why: This chunk does not show the --update-baseline handling code; it only defines the argument. Cannot verify that it is the only writer.

claims.text: --mint-commit/--confirm-mint are the ONLY entry points that persist a task to the mint store (daedalus.eval.mint.DEFAULT_MINT_STORE_PATH); every other flag above only READS it via harness.all_tasks().
claims.why: This chunk shows --mint-commit and --confirm-mint calling add_minted_task and confirm_minted_task respectively, which persist to the mint store. However, it does not show that other flags only read via all_tasks() – that would require inspecting other parts of the code.

claims.text: Output is ASCII-only for a raw Windows console.
claims.why: The function _print_ascii handles UnicodeEncodeError by encoding to ASCII with replacement, ensuring ASCII-only output.
The code in _select raises SystemExit with exactly that message when no tasks match the project filter.

observations.what: The chunk ends abruptly at the start of an if block for args.update_baseline.
The function _print_ascii attempts to write to sys.stdout.buffer without checking if it exists; if sys.stdout is a StringIO, this will raise AttributeError.
The claim that --gate is never wired into anything automatic is uncheckable in this chunk, but the argument is defined and not used in the visible code.
